title: 封神演义之黄飞虎归周
description:
Full Release Launched！

Release Coming Soon!

New Demo is Live! New Auto-Battle & Limited-Time Event Available!

Play Demo! 

Об игреCREATION OF THE GODS: The Classic Pixel JRPG Adventure· Classic single-narrative gameplay blending strategy and exploration!

· Fully handcrafted pixel art featuring characters, mythical beasts, divine artifacts, and immersive scenes!

◆ Multi-faceted Narrative: In-Scene & World Map Storytelling, Plus Combat Integration

We deliver a complete and cohesive story through various narrative approaches. Within the game, plot development is advanced via rich character dialogue and pivotal events. Additionally, the combat itself serves as a narrative element, incorporating performance sequences during key battles. These sequences utilize lively animations and dynamic camera work to convey story progression and characters' emotional states.

The Classic Gameplay System：◆ Explore Levels Freely: 

Discover chests, search environments, and converse with NPCs for clues.

◆ Gain Levels Through Combat: 

Defeat beasts and monsters to earn experience and unlock new skills.

◆ Craft Useful Items: 

Collect items to synthesize useful combat gear.

◆ Challenge Boss Guardians! 

Adjust your party formation to face guardian BOSS and advance the plot.

◆ Wield Powerful Artifacts! 

Master potent magical artifacts to deliver decisive blows.

◆ Wu Xing: Generation and Overcoming

Elemental system based on the cycle of creation and destruction.

"CREATION OF THE GODS" stands as a masterpiece of Chinese mythological literature, a widely beloved classical novel set against the Shang-Zhou dynastic war. It paints a grand celestial tapestry through Jiang Ziya's divine mission, intertwining the fates of immortals and mortal warriors. Blending profound Daoist philosophy with dazzling fantasy—magical artifacts, divine formations, and mythical creatures—the novel's romantic imagination endows it with timeless legendary appeal.

A selection of highlights from the original novel：

Chapter 30: INCIDENTS LEADING TO A REBELLION; Chapter 31: FLIGHT AND PURSUIT; Chapter 32: HUANG TIANHUA MEETS HIS FATHER; Chapter 33: THE BATTLE AT SISHUI PASS; Chapter 34: HUANG FEIHU MEETS THE PRIME MINISTER…
description_short: Enter the epic 'Creation of the Gods' saga. Experience this classic pixel JRPG with deep worldbuilding and vibrant art. Command mythical combat mounts, wield legendary artifacts, and master tactical turn-based battles. In a world where divine fate clashes with human will, only one can prevail.
